runtime.execution: Rust/asupersync core; OS child agents, jobs and Python kernel; QuickJS dedicated kernel thread and isolated extension actors.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns session kernels, services, child processes and project memory bank; consumes provider APIs and tool/service interfaces.

summary: Extensive systems-oriented Pi reconstruction with effect-aware concurrent dispatch, model code cells, managed memory/skills and child-process hub collaboration.

inspection.scope: Entry and approval posture; provider/turn/dispatch segments; actual eval kernels/bridge; hub and peer dispatcher; jobs ownership; memory transactions; extension rewriting/replacement, compaction, persistence and selected fault tests. Very large modules inspected in named segments, not line-for-line in entirety.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. No executable rebuild/outpost continuity traced. Individual media/browser/GitHub/debug/LSP implementations, all extension hostcalls, full swarm/evaluation corpus and every storage backend not exhaustively inspected. JS/Python module header comments are stale relative to actual implemented JS path; dispatch and tests determine claims.

actions.name: read / write / edit / hashline_edit / ast_edit / grep / ast_grep / find / ls
actions.lifecycle: Awaited; mutation recorder and effect classification participate in dispatch
actions.authority: Enabled selection; plan-state and approval/extension policy

actions.name: bash / jobs
actions.input: command, optional background; jobs list/wait/cancel and jobId
actions.output: Output plus session-owned job handle, rolling artifact and completion notice
actions.lifecycle: Foreground awaited or monitored background; timeout/tree teardown; foreign session id rejected
actions.authority: Model under plan/approval; ownership resolves at call time

actions.name: eval
actions.lifecycle: Persistent session Python process or JS realm; Python timeout destroys state, JS interruption can preserve it
actions.authority: Model approval; bridge read/grep/find/ls only, code itself has host language authority

actions.name: hub start / ps / logs / send / stop / restart / describe
actions.input: Launch spec/readiness gates; name; cursor/tail/grep/wait; PTY input/key/signal
actions.output: Service descriptor, bounded incremental log, readiness error
actions.lifecycle: Session service process or explicit detached process; TERM/KILL lifecycle
actions.authority: Model tool gate; owned services rather than shared-fabric consumer abstraction

actions.name: subagent
actions.input: single task / tasks + concurrency / chain; named definition, output schema and isolation
actions.output: Child final text or validated data, worktree path/diff/patch
actions.lifecycle: Bounded child-process execution; chain substitution; request-wide deadline
actions.authority: Named child configurations may pin other models; depth/host limits

actions.name: hub agent roster / transcript / steer / send / inbox / kill / revive
actions.input: op=agent, action, child name, text, optional from label
actions.output: Roster/redacted transcript or accepted bus sequence; lifecycle descriptor
actions.lifecycle: Cross-process disk steering delivered between turns; recipient must remain live; revive is new child
actions.authority: Parent model controls registry; sender label supplied, not authenticated colleague identity

actions.name: retain / recall / reflect / memory_edit / learn / manage_skill
actions.input: Fact/lesson/query/session key; memory id mutation; managed skill CRUD
actions.output: Durable fact/search/citation values or managed skill result
actions.lifecycle: SQLite transaction for bank; managed skill files separate; promotion can fail without losing lesson
actions.authority: Bank configuration and live session scope; managed marker protects user-authored skills

actions.name: current_time / browser / computer / debug / github / lsp / web_search / read_media / inspect_image / generate_image / tts / security_scan / ask / todo / submit_plan / xdev
actions.input: Individual JSON schemas; xdev tier discovers dispatchable operations
actions.lifecycle: Catalog registration traced; individual internals not all inspected
actions.authority: Selectable or host-coupled according to registry; extension/policy gates

actions.name: compact_now / shake_now / execute_extension_command
actions.input: Compaction notes/mode or registered command args
actions.lifecycle: Before-compaction interception; summary apply admission; background result later turn; shake drops old outputs without model call
actions.authority: Operator/program; extension override constrained by contract

actions.name: context / before_provider_request / tool-call / tool-result / turn lifecycle extension hooks
actions.output: Rewritten model input/results, block/cancel or lifecycle events
actions.lifecycle: Per-request/per-tool hooks with failure policies; actual core remains host loop
actions.authority: Authorized extension programs; not unrestricted model-defined scheduler replacement

actions.name: /reload / /omfg
actions.output: Reloaded resources diagnostics or grievance/rule id
actions.lifecycle: Reload refused while processing; /omfg activates stream abort/retry rule
actions.authority: Operator surface; complaint record does not capture full agent state

actions.name: SessionControlHandle.transfer_pending_to
actions.input: Finished source control handle and accepting destination
actions.output: New input receipts preserving lane and attachments
actions.lifecycle: All-or-nothing mailbox move, no replay of already delivered work
actions.authority: Embedding host controls turns; provider or executable continuity not acknowledged

filesystem.detail: Native selected read/search/write/edit tools with effect classification and optional undo recorder.

processes.detail: Background bash jobs and PTY hub services expose identities, readiness/log/input/cancel lifecycle; session-owned by default with detached option.

code_actions.detail: eval runs Python or JS code with captured cell outcomes; bridge is deliberately limited to four reading tools.

persistent_kernel.detail: Session-owned Python process namespace and dedicated persistent QuickJS thread; different timeout state-loss semantics, neither arbitrary recompile continuity.

standing_database.detail: Project SQLite fact/lesson bank and session-shared exact values are real standing data, with atomic mutation/index/audit; this is not arbitrary external operator database access.

workflow_programming.detail: Native subagent chain/parallel/schema composition plus code cells and extension hooks; no fully model-defined turn scheduler traced.

multi_model.detail: Named child definitions/role model selection permit different worker models; provider and extension request interfaces separate.

live_collaboration.detail: Model can inspect/steer registered child processes through hub disk mailboxes with acceptance sequences; delivered between turns, bounded inbox and redacted transcript; not an unrestricted shared IRC room.

concurrent_work.detail: Compatible tool effect batches run concurrently then record in call order; background jobs/services and bounded child parallel tasks provide additional overlap.

steering_interrupt.detail: Abort races provider stream and tool batches; steering generates explicit skipped results and lossless turn handoff. Individual effect/lifecycle boundaries still matter.

turn_redefinition.detail: Extensions rewrite provider context and tool outcomes, intercept compaction and lifecycle; controlled host orchestration is not wholesale hot replacement of turn definition.

compaction.detail: Model summary or non-provider shake, cancellable/replacement extension hook and quota-bounded background preparation applied on later turns.

context_repair.detail: Persisted branch graph and extension replacement of outbound context support repair composition; no traced universal model-operated restoration protocol for all lost state.

original_audit.detail: Session graph retains messages and explicit model/thinking/compaction/custom changes, but provider input is rewritten/redacted and persisted entry types do not establish every original stream/program event.

audit_query.detail: Model hub transcript reads and SQLite memory recall/audit provide bounded query primitives; complete original-audit analytical surface not traced.

hot_change.detail: Idle-only resource reload and transactional cold extension shard swap are real; candidate replaces realm after stream cleanup so old realm state does not persist by default.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

remote_services.detail: Provider and bridge/extension interfaces consume outside services; hub principally owns local PTY services rather than external shared computation fabric.

self_improvement.detail: Model can retain lessons and create/update/delete linted managed skills, with user/project precedence; no governed measured executable autoresearch/refit loop traced.

complaints.detail: Operator /omfg stores grievance text and creates active stream rule; no model-everywhere complaint command plus captured agent state/database bead contract.

authority.detail: Always-ask default and explicit yolo mode; plan mutation barrier then approval then tool hooks; secret restoration occurs before approval.

evaluation.detail: Concrete kernel, torn-mailbox and resource-trust source test oracles support experiments; they were read, not run, and do not establish full harness quality.

time_order.detail: Accepted bus sequence advances only after disk append, turn elapsed Instant budgets and timestamped parent-linked session entries; no global distributed clock guarantee.

evidence.claim: Rust entry imports asupersync and defines cross-surface approval posture with explicit yolo override.
Selectable and separately registered tool catalogs and concrete registry construction.
Owning input surface validated before consuming follow-ups; turn and elapsed-budget handling.
Provider context is extension-rewritten, secrets-filtered and abort-raced before stream admission.
Compatible effect batches run concurrently; deterministic original ordering and explicit skipped/aborted tool result pairing.
Plan-state gate and approval run before tool hooks and dispatch; results may be rewritten then secrets-masked.
Session-owned Python kernel subprocess, IO reader, process-group teardown and state slots.
Persistent JS dispatch and bridge whitelist read/grep/find/ls.
Python cell deadline kills kernel with explicit state-loss error; completed kernel returned to slot.
eval source/kernel/timeout schema and actual Python/JS dispatch.
Dedicated QuickJS thread with persistent globals, promise pump and interrupt deadline; separate from extensions.
Project-scoped memory bank and exact session-shared values; SQLite row/index/audit storage boundary.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE memory action; guarded rollback and bounded fresh-snapshot commit retries.
subagent single/parallel/chain schemas, model definitions, output schemas and worktree isolation contract.
Disk steering append precedes sequenced acceptance receipt; bounded parent inbox and cross-process steering.
Actual model hub agent roster/transcript/steer/send dispatch and redacted transcript result.
PTY service launch specs, readiness gates, bounded log ring and detached lifecycle.
hub start/ps/logs/send/stop/restart/describe/jobs/agent native schema and dispatch entry.
Background job handles and dynamically resolved owning session identity; process shutdown boundary.
Program API compact_now and shake_now; shake is non-provider output dropping, not a complaint.
Before-compaction extension can cancel or supply replacement summary; serialized application admission.
Background compaction on asupersync, subsequent-turn application and explicit quotas.
Context extension can replace outbound message list; invalid payload ignored.
Persisted session message/change/compaction/branch/custom graph with IDs, parents and timestamps, not original provider-wire inventory.
Operator reload is idle-only and asynchronously reloads resources with model registry diagnostics.
Transactional candidate JS shard construction then active-provider cleanup and cold replacement, no arbitrary realm-state continuity.
learn persists lesson and optionally promotes to managed skill, with warning on failed promotion.
manage_skill model CRUD; agent-authored marker and user/project precedence boundary.
Operator /omfg complaint logs text then generates/activates stream rule.
Grievance record contains id/time/complaint/suggested rule/resolved, no agent-state capture.
Read test oracles cover cross-cell state, promises, whitelist denial and interrupt state preservation.
Torn disk frame test checks rejection, sequence/inbox unchanged and successful repair/retry.
Reload trust test checks explicit skill survives while untrusted project resources stay excluded.
All-or-nothing finished-turn mailbox transfer preserves lane/attachments with new identities; not executable refit.

tests.focus: Kernel persistence, bridge authority and interrupted cell state
tests.oracle: Seeds globals; subsequent cell exact numeric result; bridge bash denied; infinite-loop JS cell errors and subsequent keep=5 survives. Real embedded runtime oracle in source, not executed here.

tests.focus: Torn mailbox rejection and retry atomicity
tests.oracle: Deliberately removes frame newline; append fails without advancing seq/inbox or modifying bytes; repair then retry gets seq=2 and exactly ordered messages.
Explicit CLI skill remains under untrusted reload, project skill absent; trusted manager then includes both. Resource loading oracle, not compiled executable replacement.

strengths: Separate persistent code domains behind Rust scheduler.
Concrete effect-batch concurrency with paired cancellation results.
Readiness and incremental cursor/input service interface.
Disk-first accepted steering sequence and strong torn-frame oracle.
Model-authored skill and lesson updates are explicitly distinct from user resources.

arconaut_questions: Should kernel and hub service ownership instead sit outside Arconaut behind shared customer interfaces?
Can one uniform lifecycle keep accepted steering receipts, process handles and provider requests coherent during pause/refit?
Which extension rewrites need immutable before/after original audit lineage?
Should complaint capture be decoupled from immediate rule activation and support model state attachment?
What executable refit oracle would distinguish preserved context/mailboxes from lost Python/JS identities?
